stemMarkdown: Two runners start together from the same point on a circular track 400 m long and run in opposite directions at 5 km/h and 3 km/h. After how many seconds do they meet for the first time? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Running in opposite directions their speeds add: $2.2222$ m/s. Together they must cover one full lap, so they meet after $\dfrac{400}{2.2222} = 180.0$ seconds.
